hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/tools/claude_hook.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; inp=$(cat); rc=1; out=; t=; command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1 && t="timeout ${CLAUDE_HOOK_TIMEOUT:-10}"; for py in python3 python "py -3"; do command -v "${py%% *}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; out=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | $t $py "$f" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?; break; done; [ "$rc" = 0 ] && { printf "%s" "$out"; exit 0; }; if printf "%s" "$inp" | grep -Eq "git[^|;&]*commit([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)" && ! printf "%s" "$inp" | grep -q "Claude-Session"; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "The hook could not run (python missing, crashed or timed out) and fell back to its text screen: this git commit has no Claude-Session trailer. Add --trailer with the session id, or repair tools/claude_hook.py."}}'; elif printf "%s" "$inp" | grep -Eiq 'program files|steamapps|napoleon_remastered_pc|total war|(progra|napole|empire)[a-z0-9_]*~[0-9]' && printf "%s" "$inp" | grep -Eiq '>|\b(cp|mv|rm|rmdir|mkdir|touch|tee|install|rsync|dd|tar|ln|robocopy|xcopy|copy|move|ren|del|truncate|chmod|chown|git|sed|unzip|Remove-Item|Set-Content|Add-Content|Out-File|Copy-Item|Move-Item|New-Item|taskkill|Stop-Process|pkill|killall|start|Start-Process|python3?|node|perl|ruby|powershell|pwsh)\b'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "The hook could not run (python missing, crashed or timed out) and fell back to its text screen: this call names a protected PC folder together with a write, git, launch or kill word. Use core/proxy/tools/pc_deploy.py or core/harness/job.sh, or repair python."}}'; fi; exit 0
